workload: Assess generic collection copy feasibility for the Foundations SDK
summary: An accepted Vector[String] copy helper fails native Rust compilation when a borrowed loop element is pushed into an owned result vector.
expected: The checked helper should either compile natively or receive a Moss-level diagnostic.
actual: Moss check passes, but rustc reports E0308: expected String, found &String at result.push(x).
workaround: Restrict copy helpers to Copy scalar element types until ownership-safe non-Copy transfer is proven.
notes: This was a deliberate current-main retest of a historical reproducer, not an independent natural discovery. Baseline rustc 1.98.1.
